message: Vector Rebel 3.2.64: show every SCBA airpack individually beneath Truck 504, Medic 504, and Station 4 with per-tour completed, missing, and unverified inspection marks.
releaseNotes: Removed the retired Captain Monthly action and Monthly Captain columns/requirement from Daily Captain Check. Added Apparatus Check: scans native Standard SCBA Inspection Item Logs for each assigned airpack and shows per-tour Truck 504 and Medic 504 completion, plus Station 4 SCBA Room on C-shift Mondays only. The Apparatus Check grid now displays every discovered SCBA airpack by name underneath its location, with its own per-tour native-completed green check, missing red X, unknown-history question mark, future blank, or non-Monday station dash. The location summary is computed from the same per-airpack statuses and never substitutes for them. Green means native completed inspection exists for every current airpack; red means due and missing; ? means history cannot be fully verified; future blank; other station tours not applicable. It is read-only and respects 07:00 shift boundaries. SCBA airpacks default to Pass / Present / Working: one choice maps to all 11 verified native SCBA template 113271 questions. Missing marks all 11 checks as proposed Failed with a required comment only. Fail / Issue expands 11 individually editable checks, defaulting to proposed Pass, with a required comment. Specific answers are transferred into the official Vector form when fully reviewed, while unanswered checks are left for manual completion. Live Vector failure details modal was inspected on Voyager: choosing Failed opens a required Failure Notes field and an item selection. Rebel now fills that native field from the exception comment and chooses the exact failed SCBA item. The inspector reviews and submits the final native dialog. No inspection is auto-submitted.
